resources.string: Could not prepare Tigris’s local debugging key. Check available app storage. Your existing key has been kept.

Could not connect to the TV’s local ADB service at 127.0.0.1:5555. Turning on USB or wireless debugging does not guarantee this port is available. On Android 11 and later, wireless debugging may use a separate TLS pairing flow. Report this connection stage and your firmware version; repeatedly waiting for a permission dialog will not fix a closed port.

The ADB service rejected Tigris’s debugging key. If the TV displays an authorization prompt, confirm it yourself. If no prompt appears, report “authentication rejected”; the app will not reset trusted keys or bypass pairing.

The ADB handshake did not finish before the timeout. Check whether an authorization prompt is waiting on the TV. If no prompt appears, report “handshake timeout” and the firmware version. This result alone does not prove the key was rejected.

The local port returned an incompatible ADB response. Some firmware supports only wireless TLS pairing. Report “protocol error” and the firmware version; Tigris has not changed pairing or debugging settings.
The TV closed the local ADB connection before the check completed. Report “connection closed” and the firmware version. No authorization success was recorded.
The ADB connection opened, but the shell check did not complete successfully. Report “shell check failed”. This is different from a missing authorization dialog.
The local ADB handshake failed for an unclassified reason. Report the firmware version and the LocalAdb stage/reason from the app log. Do not share debugging keys or pairing codes.
Automatic HDMI switching was unavailable. Choose the input from the TV’s settings.
This TV rejected HDMI switching and could not open its settings.
